Delhi Officials Suspended Over Medical Procurement Irregularities

The Delhi government has suspended seven officials over alleged irregularities in the procurement and storage of medicines. The move comes after a probe into a multi-crore health procurement scam, which has led to the arrest of former Delhi Director-General of Health Services (DGHS) Dr Vatsala Agarwal. The suspension is part of an ongoing investigation into the alleged scam, which involves irregularities in the procurement and storage of medicines worth over ₹600 crore. The incident highlights concerns about corruption and mismanagement in the healthcare sector.
